note: Static Stiletto: a slower dash (frames 1 and 2), the plant at the target (3), three frames of charge in which the dagger crackles and she trembles (y lifts her a hair on 4 and 6), the stab on the hit frame 7 and a slide back (8) into the idle (9); 10 fps makes it 0.9 s, about twice the Shadow Shiv.
